channel.title: Music in Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Music in Africa (musicinafrica.net)

item.title: Open call: Thought pieces on cultural exchange
item.description: The Goethe-Institut has issued an open call for proposals inviting contributions that critically examine the concept of ‘cultural exchange’, with a particular focus on its use within Africa–Europe cultural cooperation.

item.title: Tanzania: Abigail Chams drops Your Loss single, announces Visa partnership
item.description: Tanzanian artist Abigail Chams has released her first single of the year, ‘Your Loss’, accompanied by an official music video and the announcement of a new partnership with Visa.

item.title: Ghana: MOLIY named Spotify EQUAL Africa artist for January
item.description: Ghanaian-American singer and songwriter MOLIY has been named Spotify’s EQUAL Africa artist of the month for January 2026 and features on the cover of the EQUAL Global playlist.

item.title: ZIMURA property disposal sparks internal board dispute
item.description: The Zimbabwe Music Rights Association (ZIMURA) has issued a public clarification on the disposal of two residential flats in Avondale amid growing public scrutiny, while a group of its own board members has formally distanced itself from the statement, citing governance and procedural concerns.

item.title: Why Joburg’s entertainment hub still gives you the biggest head start
item.description: By Mzi Kaka South Africa’s media and entertainment sector is one of the country’s most exciting growth stories. PwC’s outlook shows that it is outperforming global benchmarks, driven by streaming, on-demand video, a resurgent film sector, and a live industry that has already surpassed its pre-pandemic revenue levels. Over the next few years, billions of rand in additional revenue are projected to flow into this space, taking the sector from roughly R289 billion (about $17.6b) to more than R320 b

item.title: Deezer unveils revamped Android TV app with enhanced music features
item.description: Deezer, the global music streaming platform, has launched a redesigned version of its Android TV app, offering an updated interface and expanded music features for users worldwide.

item.title: Open call: Live Music Lab 2026 training programme
item.description: Applications have opened for the 2026 edition of Live Music Lab, a fully funded training programme aimed at young people in Johannesburg seeking entry-level experience in the live music industry.

item.title: Wizkid and Asake release new collaborative single Jogodo
item.description: Nigerian artists Wizkid and Asake have released a new collaborative single, ‘Jogodo’, marking their latest joint project and the lead release from an upcoming EP titled REAL, Vol. 1.

item.title: Ayra Starr nominated in two categories at 2026 MOBO Awards
item.description: Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has received two nominations at the 2026 MOBO Awards, competing in both the Best African Music Act and Best International Act categories.

item.title: Cover star interview: Nigeria’s Afro-house artist Damie
item.description: Rising Nigerian Afro-house artist and producer Damie joined Nandi Madida via FaceTime on Apple Music to talk about his latest single ‘One Minute’. He also discussed how he was introduced to Afro-house, working with Davido on his Grammy nominated album Timeless and being part of Apple Music’s Africa Rising Class of 2026.
